main_body: Sci-fi building: a sloped metal roof with two vents, an orange eave trim, and a front wall with four windows and a central door
top_band: At x=32: rows 1-16 are the light blue-grey roof slope (L 148-178, with panel seams), then row 17 is a lighter edge line (L=201). Row 0 is the outline.
evidence: The roof is a large trapezoid slope seen from above, clearly separated from the wall by a light edge line (row 17), a dark shadow row (18) and an orange eave band (19-23). The wall below has a dark-framed door and windows that read as inset. The roof reads like the reference houses' roofs, so it is a proper 3/4 building and not an elevation with a hat.

style.evidence: The roof has about 5-6 lightness steps, with highlight, mid and dark seam lines, and panel seams with vents give it structure. The outline is a tinted dark navy (#1c2230), with 0% neutral dark edge pixels, so it is a material-toned outline and not sticker black. The wall panels are fairly plain, and there are only 28 distinct colours against 66 and 185 in the references. The median of 9 colours per tile is close to the 11 of the stone reference, and flat-fill coverage is only 4%. It is slightly leaner than the references but acceptable beside them.
